event: Law 39-12 on organic production of agricultural and aquatic products published in the Bulletin Officiel
relevance_to_morocco: Morocco becomes the second African country with its own organic law
National BIO MAROC label and domestic control system become operative

event: Implementing Regulation listing recognised equivalent third countries (Annex I) and recognised control bodies for equivalence (Annex II)
relevance_to_morocco: Morocco is NOT in Annex I. Its exporters operated through Annex II control bodies
Start of the three-year transition from equivalence to compliance

event: First Article 46 compliance list of control bodies adopted (17 bodies, incl. Ecocert SAS)
relevance_to_morocco: The list Moroccan exporters' certifiers must appear on

event: Article 2 of Reg. (EU) 2021/2325 ceases to apply - equivalence recognition of control bodies expires
relevance_to_morocco: End of the route Moroccan exporters had used since 2008

event: Compliance regime applies: only Article 46-recognised bodies may certify third-country organic product, against full EU production rules
relevance_to_morocco: The decisive date for Morocco. Equivalence to a local standard no longer suffices

event: Annex II of Reg. (EU) 2021/2325 declared obsolete and deleted
relevance_to_morocco: Formal closure of the equivalence-body route

event: Further amendment of the Article 46 compliance list (adds AfriCert, Organic T&C, Q-Check, SAPS)
relevance_to_morocco: Latest consolidated compliance list at the time of writing (consolidated 25 Oct 2025)

event: Commission proposes extending recognition of the 11 equivalent third countries to 31 December 2036
relevance_to_morocco: Concerns Tunisia, not Morocco - Morocco was never on that list

event: Council agrees its negotiating position on the organic simplification package
relevance_to_morocco: Shapes the post-2026 framework both Maghreb origins will operate under

event: Recognition of the 11 Annex I equivalent third countries expires (absent the proposed extension)
relevance_to_morocco: Tunisia's grandfathered advantage lapses; Morocco and Tunisia converge on the same compliance regime
